title: Do Rigid-Body Simulators Dream of Soft Robots? Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Learning contact-rich, whole-body manipulation for soft continuum robots is held back by the lack of simulation infrastructure that has accelerated rigid-robot manipulation. Existing soft robot simulators are physically grounded but lack the contact handling, actuation support, or learning integration needed for contact-rich manipulation; rigid-body approximations offer these capabilities but sacrifice physical grounding. We bridge this gap for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) by deriving a continuum-mechanics-informed discretization that places the soft robot natively inside MuJoCo, unifying tendon forces, body contact, and dynamics in a single physics pipeline. We validate the simulator against a Cosserat rod reference (static and dynamic) and real TDCR hardware. We then train state-based imitation learning policies via teleoperation in simulation and deploy them zero-shot to a physical 3-segment TDCR on a 7-DoF Franka arm across two contact-rich manipulation tasks. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich manipulation with continuum robots.
tldr: This paper presents a simulation approach for tendon-driven continuum robots in MuJoCo, enabling sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich manipulation tasks, demonstrated on a physical 3-segment robot arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在MuJoCo中模拟腱驱动连续机器人的方法，实现了接触丰富操作的仿真到现实迁移，并在物理三段式连续机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 针对软体连续体机器人的接触丰富全身操控学习，因缺乏加速刚性机器人操控的仿真基础设施而受到制约。现有软体机器人仿真器虽具有物理基础，但缺少接触丰富操控所需的接触处理、驱动支持或学习集成能力；刚体近似方法虽能提供这些功能，却牺牲了物理基础。我们针对肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR），通过推导基于连续介质力学的离散化方法，将软体机器人原生嵌入MuJoCo中，在单一物理管线内统一肌腱力、机体接触与动力学。我们基于Cosserat杆参考模型（静态与动态）及真实TDCR硬件对仿真器进行验证，随后在仿真中通过遥操作训练基于状态的模仿学习策略，并将其零样本部署到安装在7自由度Franka机械臂上的物理三节段TDCR上，完成两项接触丰富操控任务。据我们所知，这是首次在连续体机器人接触丰富操控中实现仿真到现实的迁移演示。

title: Human and AI collaboration for pulmonary nodule segmentation
summary: Medical expert annotators are scarce, and blind reliance on artificial intelligence (AI) can be misleading, motivating approaches in which humans, particularly junior medical trainees or even non-medical personnel, collaborate with AI to achieve robust medical segmentation. Although the Segment Anything Model (SAM) shows promise for general-purpose image segmentation, its performance in human-AI collaboration for specialized medical tasks has not been thoroughly evaluated. Here we present Hi-Seg, a human-in-the-loop segmentation framework for pulmonary nodules built on SAM. Humans iteratively refine prompts through trial-and-error learning and semantic reasoning, progressively guiding SAM toward higher-quality masks. Using chest CT scans from 1,179 patients across 12 centers, we conducted the first large-scale external validation of collaborative human-SAM segmentation. Across all annotator groups, Hi-Seg achieved a mean Dice score of almost 85%, outperforming five state-of-the-art deep learning models by 10-22% and 13 SAM variants by 1-29%. Hi-Seg improved segmentation accuracy while reducing annotation time for medical annotators, and briefly trained non-medical annotators achieved performance comparable to that of the junior medical student. These findings suggest that human-in-the-loop segmentation can reduce clinician workload, enable scalable crowdsourced annotation, and transform clinical workflows by facilitating the safe and efficient integration of foundation models into routine clinical practice.
tldr: Hi-Seg is a human-in-the-loop framework built on SAM for pulmonary nodule segmentation, achieving near 85% Dice score and outperforming existing models, enabling scalable annotation by non-medical personnel.
tldr_zh: Hi-Seg是一种基于SAM的人机协同肺结节分割框架，实现了近85%的Dice分数，优于现有模型，并允许非医学人员进行可扩展的标注。
summary_zh: 医学专家标注员资源稀缺，而盲目依赖人工智能可能产生误导，这促使人们探索让人类（尤其是初级医学受训者甚至非医学人员）与人工智能协作，以实现稳健的医学分割。尽管分段任意模型在通用图像分割领域展现出潜力，但其在针对专业医学任务的人机协作中的表现尚未得到充分评估。本文提出Hi-Seg——一种基于SAM的肺结节人在回路分割框架。人类通过试错学习和语义推理迭代优化提示，逐步引导SAM生成更高质量的掩膜。利用来自12个中心共1179名患者的胸部CT扫描数据，我们首次开展了人类与SAM协作分割的大规模外部验证。在所有标注员组中，Hi-Seg的平均Dice得分接近85%，比五种最先进的深度学习模型高出10–22%，比13种SAM变体高出1–29%。Hi-Seg在提升分割精度的同时，减少了医学标注员的标注时间；经简短培训的非医学标注员其表现与初级医学生相当。这些发现表明，人在回路分割能够减轻临床医生工作负担，实现可扩展的众包标注，并通过将基础模型安全高效地整合到常规临床实践中，重塑临床工作流程。
